controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: Cassini clear-filter observations projected onto the released PDS shape using its measured camera geometry. Bounded illumination correction and exposure matching reduce photographed lighting. Gray grid marks unavailable samples; cast-shadow terrain is not reconstructed.
controls.summary: Brightness matching reduces photographed shading. The gray grid marks missing coverage and terrain hidden in cast shadows.
controls.title: ISS mosaic

controls.label: False color
controls.description: Cassini ISS NAC IR3, green and UV3 filters projected independently with the released PDS shape-camera table. Colors explicitly encode those three bands as red, green and blue; they are not natural color or a calibrated albedo map. Gray grid marks terrain outside the common reliable observation footprint and cast-shadow terrain is not reconstructed. The filters span 14 minutes and phase angles of 66–78 degrees. Hue can reflect changing illumination as well as filter response; it does not establish composition.
controls.summary: False color from registered source filters. The images were taken minutes apart, so changing illumination also affects hue. Gray grid marks missing common coverage.
controls.title: Cassini false color

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Radial height above a 12.35 km reference sphere from the Cassini shape model. Includes the moon’s broad irregular shape; it is not local height above a geoid. Fixed relief lighting reveals model slopes. Small craters are not reliably resolved.
controls.summary: Height relative to a 12.35 km sphere, from the Cassini shape model. Small craters are unresolved.
controls.title: Shape-derived radial height
